title: 裁切结果审核
intent: 新裁切产生后独立审核，不把使用裁切当作审批。
brief: Stage5 裁切画布 ACTIVE 待审核. Title "检查裁切结果". One large final-cropped transparent fox preview, NO drag handles or crop-edit outline. Right noninteractive checks "主体没有被切掉" / "边缘留白合适". Footer ONE teal "通过裁切结果", outlined "调整裁切边界", quiet "驳回裁切结果". Note "通过后设置印刷尺寸，当前结果尚未保存。". Do not say PNG final or show save forms. This is customer route crop review, not crop edit.

intent: 去背景独立处理状态，无假进度。
brief: Stage4 去除背景 ACTIVE running; stage3completed. Title "正在去除背景". Original cream source preview labeled "本次输入（参考）"; no processed result. Spinner only, exact "处理进度暂不可估算"; "PrintFlow 正在操作美图秀秀，请稍候。". title: TIFF白墨预览
intent: 最终审核中的白墨查看状态，图例明确。
brief: Stage7 waiting final TIFF review. Title "检查白墨覆盖". Same final review shell but toolbar tabs "颜色" inactive / "白墨" ACTIVE / "透明" inactive. ONE dominant black canvas with WHITE silhouette of same fox and every flower/foliage region; no orange/color artwork in this mode. Exact legend "亮部 = 有白墨 · 黑色 = 无白墨". This mask is illustrative mockup artwork, NOT real decoder output. Right checks "细小区域有没有缺失" / "轮廓外有没有多余白墨"; metadata "W1 · 内缩 0 px", "150 × 200 mm · 300 PPI". Footer primary "批准此 TIFF", secondary "驳回此 TIFF"; note "审批针对完整 TIFF；查看白墨不代表通过。". No separate white-only approval or save form.
